Twenty-five percent of small business owners cited inflation as their single most important business problem, an increase of two points from February. Concurrently, the net percentage of owners expecting higher real sales decreased by eight points to a net negative 18%.

This decline coincided with a four-day sell-off that pushed the US dollar to its lowest level since early 2022. The market movements occurred as day traders and financial institutions aggressively adjusted their positions ahead of U.S. President Donald Trump's highly anticipated speech at the 56th World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland.
